back: A template defining the properties and methods of a kind of object.
One item created from a class, with its own values for the properties.
Private data accessed only through public methods, which can check it.
A subclass takes the properties and methods of a superclass and can add or override them.
The same method name behaves differently for objects of different classes.
A subclass redefines a method inherited from the superclass.
An object has another object as a property: a has-a relationship.
The method that runs when an object is created: NEW in 9618 pseudocode, __init__ in Python.
Is-a (a Bus is a Vehicle) means inheritance; has-a (a Car has an Engine) means containment.
